headline.en: Inspect dependency text before an agent treats it as instruction.
headline.zh: 在 Agent 将依赖文本当指令前先检查它。

sub.en: PromptAudit resolves supported dependency inputs, gathers package text, and applies a curated rule corpus to identify suspicious instruction patterns.
sub.zh: PromptAudit 解析支持的依赖输入、收集包文本，并应用规则语料识别可疑指令模式。

body.en: Rules target instructions aimed at coding agents.
body.zh: 规则针对面向编码 Agent 的指令。

body.en: Findings carry package and source locations.
Missing fetches remain visible to the operator.
body.zh: 缺失抓取结果仍对操作者可见。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Scan tests/fixtures/jqwik_payload.txt as inert text using the production rule corpus, then print rule IDs, severity and line numbers.
note.zh: 用生产规则语料把 tests/fixtures/jqwik_payload.txt 作为惰性文本扫描，打印规则 ID、级别与行号。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: The shipped payload fixture is scanned as inert text through the production corpus. No package download or payload execution.

body.en: Scan tests/fixtures/jqwik_payload.txt as inert text using the production rule corpus, then print rule IDs, severity and line numbers.
body.zh: 用生产规则语料把 tests/fixtures/jqwik_payload.txt 作为惰性文本扫描，打印规则 ID、级别与行号。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/promptaudit.git
cd promptaudit
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: Pattern scanning can miss unfamiliar attacks and can flag benign text. A clean scan is not proof that a package is safe.
limitations.zh: 模式扫描可能漏掉新攻击，也可能命中正常文本。无发现不证明包安全。

limitations.en: Normal scan may contact package registries. The recorded demo scans an included text fixture without fetching or executing a package.
limitations.zh: 普通 scan 可能访问包注册表；记录示例只扫描随仓文本，不抓取或执行包。

limitations.en: Unresolved, skipped or unscanned packages are coverage gaps, not clean results.
limitations.zh: 未解析、跳过或未扫描的包是覆盖缺口，不是干净结果。

body.en: Dependency README and error text can be read by coding agents during normal work. A local text scan makes recognizable instruction payloads and unscanned packages visible before you rely on that material.
body.zh: 编码 Agent 在正常工作中可能读取依赖 README 和错误文本。文本扫描让可识别的指令载荷与未扫描包在被采用前显现。

body.en: The resolver enumerates packages, the fetcher writes bounded cached text, and scanner runs ecosystem-filtered patterns over README, summary and error strings. Findings retain rule, package, version and source location. The CLI also surfaces incomplete coverage.
body.zh: 解析器列举包，抓取器写入有边界的缓存文本，扫描器按生态筛选规则并匹配 README、简介与错误字符串。结果保留规则、包、版本和源位置；CLI 同时展示覆盖缺口。

body.en: The resolver enumerates packages, the fetcher writes bounded cached text, and scanner runs ecosystem-filtered patterns over README, summary and error strings. Findings retain rule, package, version and source location. The CLI also surfaces incomplete coverage.
body.zh: 解析器列举包，抓取器写入有边界的缓存文本，扫描器按生态筛选规则并匹配 README、简介与错误字符串。结果保留规则、包、版本和源位置；CLI 同时展示覆盖缺口。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Supported project inputs include package-lock.json, poetry.lock and requirements.txt. Inspect CLI coverage output when dependency resolution or fetch fails; target Python/platform settings are available for cross-environment resolution. Customize the corpus only with reproducible examples.
body.zh: 支持的项目输入包括 package-lock.json、poetry.lock 和 requirements.txt。解析或抓取失败时应检查 CLI 覆盖输出；目标 Python/platform 设置支持跨环境解析。规则定制应基于可复现示例。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
promptaudit scan .
promptaudit scan . --json
promptaudit rules
